 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Govt decreases petrol price Rs3 per litre, keeps diesel rate unchanged
 Business Recorder • 17 Nov 2026, 9:46 PM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f The government has cut petrol by Rs3 per litre to Rs325, while leaving high-speed diesel at Rs358 per litre, Business Recorder reported. The revised ex-depot rates, announced by OGRA on Tuesday, take effect on Wednesday, November 18, under the federal government’s petroleum pricing mechanism.
 This follows a separate Rs2-per-litre reduction in both petrol and diesel on Monday, which had taken petrol to Rs328 and kept diesel at Rs358. International crude benchmarks edged up on Tuesday, although Brent and West Texas Intermediate had declined 21% and 18% respectively this month, according to the report. The change is relevant to fuel consumers and the oil marketing sector, while the diesel price remains unchanged.
 At a glance
 Petrol falls by Rs3 to Rs325 per litre from November 18.
 Diesel stays at Rs358 per litre.
 Brent and WTI have fallen 21% and 18% this month, respectively.
